mapper.select: select id, dept_id as deptId, report_id as reportId, status, output_kind as outputKind, progress, snapshot_sha256 as snapshotSha256, input_snapshot_json as inputSnapshotJson, ai_enabled as aiEnabled, docx_file_id as docxFileId, pdf_file_id as pdfFileId, error_message as errorMessage, llm_call_count as llmCallCount from report_generation_job where id = #{id}

select j.input_snapshot_json from report_generation_job j inner join report_task t on t.id = j.report_id and t.dept_id = j.dept_id where j.dept_id = #{deptId} and t.report_year = #{reportYear} and t.deleted_flag = '0' and j.status = 'succeeded' and j.input_snapshot_json is not null order by j.id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into report_generation_job ( dept_id, report_id, status, output_kind, progress, snapshot_sha256, input_snapshot_json, ai_enabled, docx_file_id, pdf_file_id, error_message, llm_call_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{deptId}, #{reportId}, #{status}, #{outputKind}, #{progress}, #{snapshotSha256}, #{inputSnapshotJson}, #{aiEnabled}, #{docxFileId}, #{pdfFileId}, #{errorMessage}, #{llmCallCount}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now() )
mapper.update: update report_generation_job set status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, docx_file_id = #{docxFileId}, pdf_file_id = #{pdfFileId}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, llm_call_count = #{llmCallCount}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and dept_id = #{deptId}
update report_generation_job set status = 'failed', error_message = 'application restarted', update_time = now() where status in ('queued', 'processing')
mapper.select: select id, dept_id as deptId, report_id as reportId, status, output_kind as outputKind, progress, snapshot_sha256 as snapshotSha256, ai_enabled as aiEnabled, docx_file_id as docxFileId, pdf_file_id as pdfFileId, error_message as errorMessage, llm_call_count as llmCallCount from report_generation_job where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = 'succeeded' order by id desc limit 1
select docx_file_id from report_generation_job where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = 'succeeded' and docx_file_id is not null order by id desc limit 1
select pdf_file_id from report_generation_job where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = 'succeeded' and pdf_file_id is not null order by id desc limit 1
